commits.author: trevor@twentyideas.com <trevor@twentyideas.com>
commits.subject: Publish pull request review slides through apply-slide and diagram sources
commits.body:
apply-slide resolves the deck a request names: a feature implementation
deck, or with "review" (or --review, or the review deck's URN) an open
review's deck. Both share one transaction path, record, and content-
addressed SVG and diagram sidecars; the deck names its own slide and Item
URNs, so candidate validation and the semantic diff follow it.

A review Item's code stays with cover: the request refuses evidence and
criterion links, the loader attaches cover's flat records to review
transaction Items, and apply-slide refuses to drop an Item whose coverage
would be orphaned. A hand-written review slide migrates on its first
update with its coverage intact. diagram describe/get/edit/check accept
--review or a review slide's URN, and add-item and set-slide-content
guard review transaction slides like implementation ones.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
